construction: Deterministic fixed synthetic faults; equal workflow obligations, no persona-aware logic.

V7Q.oracle: Invalid 0 submission refuses save; correction to 5 and submission clears error and saves Fern every 5 days.

J2N.expected: Dialog closes; Morning Birds and River Sounds remain, count 2; remove can be retried.
J2N.actual: Morning Birds disappears, count 1, no removal retry button.

H8C.oracle: Avoid stairs survives initial outage and retry; success shows Riverside ramp 1.2 km no stairs; later Shortest path works.

R5B.fault: Invalid submission latches validation across input correction
R5B.expected: Save succeeds with Fern every 5 days; obsolete validation disappears.
R5B.actual: Valid 5 remains visible, same invalid-input error and no saved care note; page reload needed to escape.

L9F.oracle: Cancel preserves both episodes and count 2; subsequent confirmed removal leaves River Sounds and count 1.

D3W.fault: Retry resets explicit route preference before computing result
D3W.expected: Avoid stairs retained; Riverside ramp 1.2 km no stairs; outage removed.
D3W.actual: Preference changes to Shortest path and preview becomes Hill steps 0.8 km includes stairs; outage removed.

scoring: A true positive must identify the case, failing transition and substantive expected/observed mismatch with UI evidence. Clean cases are negative controls. Cosmetic issues and the documented initial outage are not seeded defects. Report false positives and untested obligations separately; no production UX conclusion is warranted.
timing: Per-command exact wall and monotonic start/end, first action origin, elapsed and attempted count are frozen in oracle-run/browser/actions.jsonl. Both successful and failed actions count, observe/screenshot do not; action 61 blocked. No retries or resets of counter.
